column1: @ SELECT t.name, t.ncol, t.wr, t.strict FROM pragma_table_list t WHERE t.schema = 'main' AND t.type = 'table' AND t.name NOT GLOB 'sqlite_*' AND t.name NOT GLOB '_cf_*' ORDER BY t.name

@ SELECT t.name, c.name, c.type, CASE WHEN c.pk > 0 THEN NULL ELSE c."notnull" END, c.pk, c.hidden FROM pragma_table_list t, pragma_table_xinfo(t.name) c WHERE t.schema = 'main' AND t.type = 'table' AND t.name NOT GLOB 'sqlite_*' AND t.name NOT GLOB '_cf_*' ORDER BY t.name, c.name

@ SELECT t.name, CASE WHEN i.origin = 'c' THEN i.name END, i."unique", i.origin, (SELECT group_concat(x.name, ',') FROM (SELECT name FROM pragma_index_info(i.name) ORDER BY seqno) x) FROM pragma_table_list t, pragma_index_list(t.name) i WHERE t.schema = 'main' AND t.type = 'table' AND t.name NOT GLOB 'sqlite_*' AND t.name NOT GLOB '_cf_*' ORDER BY 1, 4, 5
@ SELECT count(*) FROM pragma_table_list t, pragma_foreign_key_list(t.name) f WHERE t.schema = 'main' AND t.type = 'table' AND t.name NOT GLOB 'sqlite_*' AND t.name NOT GLOB '_cf_*'
